# situation: a step runs example-org/docker-action@v1, a Docker container
#   action of another repository whose runs.image is
#   docker://ghcr.io/o/scan:1, named by a tag and no digest.
# reason: the runner pulls the image the tag 1 names when the step runs;
#   action.definition answers the file of the action, as the archive the
#   runner downloads has it.
# attack: whoever can push to ghcr.io/o/scan pushes an image of theirs
#   under the tag 1.
# attack-run-behavior: the runner pulls ghcr.io/o/scan:1, which is now that
#   image, and runs the step inside it with the workspace mounted.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: example-org/docker-action@v1

on: workflow_call
jobs:
  a:

    steps:
      - uses: example-org/docker-action@v1
